items.t: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Scolds Europe on AI Race
items.d: The CEO urges the bloc to get serious and harness its strengths to join the AI race
items.fullText: Newsletter Tech In Depth Nvidia’s Huang Goads Europe to Pick Up The Pace in AI Race The CEO urges the bloc to get serious and harness its strengths to join the AI race Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift Expand Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang delivers the keynote address at the company’s GTC in Berlin. Photographer: Alex Kraus/Bloomberg Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift Gift this article Contact us: Provide news feedback or report an error Confidential tip? Welcome to Tech In Depth, our daily newsletter about the business of tech from Bloomberg’s journalists around the world. Today, Christina Kyriasoglou reports on Nvidia chief Jensen Huang’s tour through Europe. Meta’s new shares: The social media company wants to issue a new class of nonvoting stock aimed at generating more money for its big bet on artificial intelligence. Meta also boosted its capital spending outlook .

items.fullText: 반도체 소부장 삼성전기, 엔비디아 등 美 빅테크로부터 AI 반도체 기판 전용라인 증설 투자 유치 발행일 : 2026-10-22 18:46 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 삼성전기 FC-BGA. 〈사진 삼성전기 제공〉 삼성전기가 엔비디아 등 빅테크 기업으로부터 투자를 받아 인공지능(AI) 반도체용 기판 생산 시설을 증설한다. 글로벌 빅테크 기업들이 고성능 반도체 기판의 안정적인 수급을 위해 전용라인 투자에 나섰다. 22일 업계에 따르면 삼성전기는 엔비디아 등과 공동 투자를 통해 세종 사업장에 패키지 기판 생산을 위한 신규 공장 증설에 나선다. 엔비디아는 2조원대, 다른 빅테크 기업은 1조원대 규모 자금을 투자한다. 삼성전기의 생산능력 증설에 필요한 자금 일부를 투자해 전용 생산라인을 구축하고 안정적으로 부품을 조달받기 위해서다. 양사 투자는 지난달 삼성전기가 국내 세종 사업장 내 플립칩-볼그리드어레이(FC-BGA) 공장에 총 4조2700억원 규모 증설 투자를 결정했다고 발표한 일환이다. 이 중 상당 부분을 엔비디아와 다른 빅테크 기업이 투자해 지원하는 국면이다. 삼성전기는 전날 엔비디아 전용 생산설비를 구축한다고 발표한 바 있다. FC-BGA는 칩과 메인보드를 연결해 데이터를 주고받는 핵심 부품이다. AI 반도체의 연산 성능이 높아질수록 처리하는 데이터가 많아지고 이를 전달하기 위한 연결 회로도 늘어난다. 이에 기판의 크기가 커지고 회로를 여러 층으로 쌓는 고다층화가 필요해진다. 다만 고성능 반도체 기판 제조에는 고난도 기술이 요구된다. 면적이 넓어지고 층수가 높아질수록 신호 손실을 막기 위한 초미세 회로 구현과 열변형에 따른 휨 현상(Warpage)을 억제하는 평탄도 유지 기술 역량이 필요하다. 또 초고속 연산 과정에서 발생하는 전력 노이즈를 억제하고 전력 효율을 극대화해야 한다. AI 반도체가 고성능화할수록 고성능 반도체 기판 중요성도 커지고 있다. 반도체 기판 수요도 폭발적으로 증가하고 있다보니 공급을 크게 상회하고 있다. 장덕현 삼성전기 사장은 올 3월 주주총회에서 “캐파보다 고객 수요가 50% 이상 상회하고 있어 보완 투자와 공장 확대 등에 대한 계획을 수립하고 있다”고 밝힌 바 있다. 이를 안정적으로 제조할 수 있는 역량을 가진 기판 업체는 제한적이다. 공급을 단기간에 대폭 늘리기 어렵고 제조 역량을 갖춘 업체는 제한적이다보니, 글로벌 빅테크 기업이 전용 생산라인 구축을 위한 투자 비용을 지원하며 장기 공급계약을 맺는 것으로 분석된다. 김영호 기자 lloydmind@etnews.com

items.t: Nvidia's Huang Says Neoclouds Are 'Good Investment'

items.fullText: Oct 22nd, 2026 Nvidia's Huang Says Neoclouds Are 'Good Investment' Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang discusses neoclouds and why they are a good investment. "The demand of their compute is incredible," Huang tells Bloomberg's Tom Mackenzie. He also addresses the need for neoclouds to acquire more working capital as demand for computers and AI is high. "Everything else will get solved when demand is high," Huang says, adding he is "quite confident" neoclouds will find solutions. items.t: 삼성전기, 테슬라·엔비디아서 3.6조 유치
items.fullText: 산업 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 삼성전기, 테슬라·엔비디아서 3.6조 유치 입력 2026.10.22 17:37 수정 2026.10.22 19:36 지면 A12 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 노유정 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. "AI칩 기판 생산시설 구축" 삼성전기가 엔비디아 및 테슬라와 인공지능(AI) 반도체 패키지 기판 플립칩볼그리드어레이(FC-BGA)를 장기 공급하는 계약을 체결했다. 테슬라와 엔비디아는 각각 1조원, 2조6000억원을 투자해 삼성전기 세종사업장에 전용 생산시설을 짓는다. 부산사업장에도 엔비디아 전용 공장 구축 계획을 밝힌 만큼 추가 투자가 단행될 것으로 전망된다. 22일 업계에 따르면 삼성전기는 테슬라와 FC-BGA를 다년간 공급하는 계약을 맺고 전용 생산 라인을 증설하고 있다. FC-BGA는 반도체 칩과 메인보드를 연결하는 고성능 패키지 기판이다. 대용량 전력과 전기 신호를 안정적으로 공급해 AI 반도체에서 주요 부품으로 꼽힌다. FC-BGA는 AI 열풍으로 최근 수요가 급증하고 있지만 기술 장벽이 높아 최근 품귀 현상이 발생하고 있다. FC-BGA를 생산할 수 있는 제조사가 많지 않아서다. 장덕현 삼성전기 사장은 지난 3월 “서버·데이터센터용 FC-BGA 수요가 생산능력보다 50% 이상 많다”고 밝혔다. 지난달 삼성전기는 4조2700억원을 투입해 국내 세종사업장 내 신규 공장을 증설하겠다고 발표했다. 여기에 엔비디아가 2조6000억원, 테슬라가 1조원을 투자해 전용 라인을 짓는 방식이다. 삼성전기는 양사를 포함한 공급사에 다년간 FC-BGA를 공급한다. 앞서 21일 삼성전기는 엔비디아와 전략적 비즈니스 파트너십을 체결했다. 엔비디아는 세종 외 부산사업장에도 삼성전기와 공동 투자해 전용 공장을 구축하기로 했다. 엔비디아는 기존에 일본 이비덴으로부터 FC-BGA를 납품받았지만 최근 공급난이 심해지자 삼성전기에도 러브콜을 보낸 것으로 알려졌다. 부산사업장 투자 규모는 추후 계약을 통해 확정될 예정이다. 노유정 기자 yjroh@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 노유정 기자 산업부 노유정 기자입니다. 반도체 및 전자, 가전 기사를 쓰고 있습니다. 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스, LG그룹 등을 취재합니다. 엔비디아와 AMD, 램리서치 등 한국에 진출한 글로벌 반도체 기업의 동향도 들여다봅니다. 신문에서는 증권부와 유통산업부, 사회부 경찰팀 등을 거쳤습니다. 최근에는 한국경제신문의 유튜브 채널인 한경 코리아마켓과 집코노미를 담당했습니다. items.t: LG이노텍, 엔비디아와 '로봇 눈' 솔루션 개발
items.fullText: 산업 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 LG이노텍, 엔비디아와 '로봇 눈' 솔루션 개발 입력 2026.10.22 17:36 수정 2026.10.22 17:36 지면 A12 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 원종환 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 카메라 모듈 센싱 기술 공개 LG이노텍이 엔비디아 최신 기술을 접목한 로봇·피지컬 인공지능(AI)용 센싱 솔루션을 공개했다고 22일 발표했다. 모바일 카메라 모듈 분야에서 축적한 기술을 활용해 피지컬 AI 사업 고도화에 속도를 내겠다는 방침이다. LG이노텍은 지난 20일 독일 베를린에서 개막한 엔비디아의 개발자 행사 ‘GTC 베를린’에서 엔비디아 최신 기술인 ‘홀로스캔 센서 브리지(HSB)’를 적용한 피지컬 AI와 로봇용 센싱 솔루션 라인업을 공개했다. HSB는 센서에서 수집한 데이터를 중앙처리장치(CPU)를 거치지 않고 AI 컴퓨터로 바로 보낼 수 있는 기술이다. 두 회사는 휴머노이드 로봇용 비전 센싱과 로봇 손 등의 분야에서 협업을 확대할 예정이다. 문혁수 LG이노텍 사장은 “이번 협력은 LG이노텍의 차별화한 복합 센싱 솔루션을 글로벌 시장에 확산하는 기회”라며 “센싱은 물론 통신 모듈, 반도체 기판 등을 아우르며 시장을 빠르게 선점해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다. 원종환 기자 won0403@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 원종환 기자 안녕하세요, 원종환 한국경제 산업부 기자입니다. 중소기업부에서 소부장기업을, 정치부에서 민주당을 출입했습니다. October 21, 2026 by Vladimir Troy 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Companies around the world are building on the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform to plan, simulate and run the grid and the AI factory as one system, from the substation to the rack. Their adoption of the platform responds to an acute problem. Power is now the biggest bottleneck in infrastructure. More than $300 billion in equipment is backlogged, and over 200 gigawatts of projects are waiting in U.S. interconnection queues. One root cause of the bottleneck is siloed systems. The grid, the facility and the compute inside have long been designed independently from one another, creating the conditions for delays, risk and stranded capacity. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements To help address this, NVIDIA DSX brings these systems together: NVIDIA DSX Sim and SimReady assets from leading energy manufacturers let engineers simulate the grid, substation and AI factory together, validating generators, switchgear, power systems and cooling before breaking ground. NVIDIA DSX Flex syncs AI factory demand with grid conditions and onsite generation, turning AI factories from static loads into flexible grid assets. NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS and DSX Exchange squeeze more compute from every watt and securely share signals across compute, networking, energy, cooling and operations. GE Vernova is deploying its grid-to-facility and rack power expertise to complement NVIDIA DSX systems, enabling customers to transform power constraints into competitive advantages while maximizing compute and token output, sustainability and grid reliability. items.fullText: Pioneers Across Europe Deploy NVIDIA Earth-2 Open Models to Power Real-World Weather and Climate Prediction October 21, 2026 by Mike Pritchard 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Weather forecasts shape more than daily plans; timely weather information is crucial for energy producers, insurers and transport operators to plan around changing conditions. A global forecast can show a storm taking shape, but decisions about solar farms, shipping routes or insured property depend on what happens locally. NVIDIA Earth-2 gives developers and researchers a family of open AI models and tools they can customize with their own data. Running on NVIDIA computing, these technologies support global weather prediction, detailed regional forecasts and environmental research. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements StormScope EU is the latest model to join Earth-2 — a regional version of the StormScope model for short-term forecasting, trained over Europe weather and climate data. It uses EUMETSAT satellite observations to predict evolving cloud conditions across 16 Meteosat channels at 10-minute intervals. At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is showcasing a live StormScope EU pipeline in an interactive weather demo built in partnership with Earthmover . The demo uses Earth2Studio to run forecasts and Earthmover’s data platform to manage and serve the real-time results, which are updated as soon as new satellite observations come in, every 10 minutes. Earthmover serves these results as map tiles, letting visitors explore predictions across Europe without downloading entire datasets. Developers can combine Earth-2 models in workflows tailored to regional needs, using StormScope for short-term forecasting and CorrDiff to add local detail to coarser weather data. items.fullText: Europe’s Industrial Leaders Reinvent Engineering and Manufacturing With NVIDIA October 21, 2026 by James McKenna 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! To increase productivity, accelerate innovation and create new opportunities for economic growth, Europe’s industrial leaders are tapping NVIDIA CUDA-X and Omniverse libraries , as well as NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron open models, across the engineering and manufacturing lifecycle. Bringing those capabilities together on the factory floor, the NVIDIA Factory Operations Blueprint (FOX) is now available in early access on GitHub , providing a path for developers to build and deploy always-on factory manager agents that coordinate work across machines, and specialist agents focused on use cases such as visual inspection, root cause analysis, report generation and fleet management. These agents can connect to frontier models, including NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron, and foundational knowledge including computer-aided design, product lifecycle management, simulation software, and IT and operational technology systems. Building on the FOX blueprint enables the ecosystem to build industrial agents that monitor factory operations in real time, correlate visual findings and machine logs to investigate problems, and coordinate responses. With Cosmos in-context learning, these agents can adapt using examples and documentation, without fine-tuning. Siemens is integrating agents built using FOX into Intelligence Center X, its agentic enterprise system, to help identify root causes and coordinate factory operations, for estimated cost savings of 20%. Siemens’ Process Preparation X agents use NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory tools and skills to generate defect images for circuit-board inspection. At its Erlangen electronics factory, Siemens used this approach to reduce calibration time of inspection processes by 40%. items.fullText: NVIDIA cuDSS Now Generally Available to Accelerate Engineering and Scientific Simulations October 21, 2026 by Timothy Costa 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA cuDSS, launched today in general availability, is an NVIDIA CUDA-X library that shifts a critical part of engineering and scientific simulations onto GPUs. Complex engineering feats — from advanced chips to aircraft to industrial systems —– depend on simulation to predict how designs will perform before they’re built. As designs become more complex, simulations take longer to run, increasing computing demands and limiting the number of ideas teams can test. NVIDIA cuDSS accelerates solving large sparse systems — the math-heavy step that repeats throughout engineering and scientific simulations and often limits how many designs a team can test — by tapping into GPUs. This lets applications reduce time to results and increase simulation throughput, enabling end users to explore larger more realistic models, more accurate representations and a wider design space at a reduced cost. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Industry leaders are already integrating NVIDIA cuDSS into their tools to transform workflows for their end customers: Applied Materials: With cuDSS, Applied Materials accelerated sparse solves in Ginestra, its physics-based, defect-centric simulation platform, by up to 10x versus CPU-only approaches, speeding exploration of semiconductor materials and device reliability. COMSOL: Using COMSOL Multiphysics with NVIDIA cuDSS on NVIDIA accelerated computing, ZEISS SMT achieved a measured 4x speedup in an EUV lithography plasma simulation benchmark, completing the full simulation in six days and 14 hours. Cadence : Uses cuDSS in its Celsius software to accelerate simulations of heat, structural stress and warpage in advanced chips and 3D chip designs, helping customers including Nokia analyze complex designs faster. NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation helps enterprises turn data into company intelligence agents can use. Agents can find relevant information, understand what it means for the business and use it to make predictions and help people decide what to do next. Companies can use Agent Knowledge Foundation without moving data, rebuilding existing workflows or changing governance controls. The foundation features NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries , including cuDF, cuGraph, cuML, cuOpt and cuVS, and the new Auto-Ontology library, which translates raw company data into familiar business concepts — like customers, products and orders — and maps how they relate. items.fullText: GTC Berlin 2026: Live Updates From NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang’s Keynote October 21, 2026 by Brian Caulfield 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Founded in a tent near the Berlin Wall in 1980, the Tempodrom moved several times before settling near Anhalter Bahnhof in 2001. Its permanent home has since hosted concerts, galas and political events. Today, it hosts a different kind of spectacle. GTC Berlin runs three days, with more than 100 sessions on agentic AI, robotics, physical AI, open models and accelerated computing underway at STATION-Berlin down the road. Here, journalists, analysts and partners have gathered for the main event: NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang’s keynote. Huang Takes the Stage Huang opened with a question: What do L’Oréal, Revolut, Spotify, Merck, Vodafone, Zara, Porsche, Nestlé and HSBC have in common? They’re all European companies and they’re all working with NVIDIA on AI, he said. The keynote comes on the heels of NVIDIA’s weeklong road across Europe — Paris, London, Stockholm, Dublin — with the company committing nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem across Europe and working with 12,000+ partners. “After decades of advancement in the computer industry, we are now at the beginnings of a new industrial revolution,” Huang said. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements AI is a five-layer cake , Huang explained. Energy powers advanced computers that are part of an AI factory, which generates tokens and digital intelligence from the models that run on it, which are then integrated into every application. “Long before the AI models emerge, the infrastructure has to exist,” he said, highlighting how, similarly, the internet first needed networking, and electricity first required the grid. “To be part of this AI economy, you don’t want to just be consuming the AI; you want to be producing the AI,” Huang said. “We could do all of that here in Europe, and in fact, we’ve already started.” The AI Fac

Nebius and Nscale are among global technology partners looking to NVIDIA Vera CPUs to build the next wave of infrastructure. Their momentum reflects rapid advancements in agentic computing. Agents do more than generate answers: they retrieve information, run software tools, execute code and evaluate results. Each step depends on fast CPU processing. Vera accelerates that work, helping agents respond faster and enabling data centers to make better use of computing capacity. Vera is designed to sustain that speed even when running thousands of tasks simultaneously, helping organizations expand services without trading responsiveness for scale. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Building Europe’s Computing Capacity AI cloud providers Nebius , Nscale and Verda are building with Vera to support the growing computing needs of businesses and developers. High-performance, energy-efficient CPUs help these providers scale the data processing and software execution behind services, alongside the GPUs running models. The broader sovereign AI ecosystem also includes Aleria , a sovereign AI infrastructure and platform provider, supporting demand for infrastructure that keeps data and operations under customers’ control. The Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC) ’s AI Factory Accelerator Programme, now in full operation following a pilot initiative, gives startups access to sovereign compute, technical support and training to support innovation across industries. Many of these companies are also members of the NVIDIA Inception program for cutting-edge startups — and as of today, access to some of the BSC AI Factory services are available through the NVIDIA Inception portal . NVIDIA Inception complements the BSC AI Factory Accelerator Programme by providing members with training through NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute open courses, business mentoring, venture capital connections and other resources. An upcoming extension of MareNostrum 5 — BSC’s public infrastructure serving scientific and technological innovation, powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing — will deliver supercomputing access through the BSC AI Factory and other AI Factories across Europe. BSC AI Factory is among Europe’s first AI factories and the first in Spain, and has delivered more than 800 services to private and public-sector clients since its April 2025 launch. items.fullText: Germany Wants to Lead the World in Industrial AI: How NVIDIA Will Help German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang discussed how to merge traditional German engineering with state-of-the-art AI. October 19, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! In the cavernous hall of Kraftwerk, a former power station in Berlin, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang sat down to discuss Germany’s AI roadmap, and in particular, the industrial applications of AI. Huang opened by tracing NVIDIA’s longstanding relationship with German industry, beginning with gaming systems, workstations and automotive design in the early 2000s and leading to today’s partnerships in autonomous vehicle development and digital twins for manufacturing. The conversation focused on how Germany can make the most of the AI revolution by playing to its strengths in manufacturing and automotive — and by encouraging AI adoption across the country’s ecosystem of small and medium-sized companies. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Earlier in the day, as part of the Invest in Germany Summit, Chancellor Merz, the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy and the Federal Ministry for Research, Technology and Space signed a Joint Declaration of Intent with NVIDIA. The German federal government’s aim is to merge traditional German engineering and manufacturing expertise with cutting-edge research and AI technology. The declaration sets out an agreement to work on a joint initiative with NVIDIA to advance cutting edge AI models for physical AI.
